items.summary: Extend the backend actor to expose an admin-only function `setUserRole(userId: Principal, role: {#admin; #teacher; #student}) : async Result` that allows an admin to change any user's assigned role. Guard the call so only a principal with the #admin role can invoke it.

Extend the backend actor to expose an admin-only function `deleteUser(userId: Principal) : async Result` that permanently removes a user profile, all associated bookings, activity logs, performance metrics, and review records from stable storage.

Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only functions for booking management: `adminUpdateBookingStatus(bookingId: Text, status: BookingStatus) : async Result` to force-update any booking's status, and `adminDeleteBooking(bookingId: Text) : async Result` to permanently remove a booking record.

Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only content moderation functions: `deleteReview(reviewId: Text) : async Result` to remove any review, and `deleteMessage(messageId: Text) : async Result` to remove any message from any conversation thread.

Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only system configuration functions: `setStripeConfig(secretKey: Text, allowedCountries: [Text]) : async Result` (already partially exists — ensure it is admin-gated), `setPlatformCommissionRate(rateBps: Nat) : async Result` to update the platform commission percentage stored in stable state, and `getPlatformConfig() : async PlatformConfig` to retrieve current configuration values.

Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only withdrawal management functions: `approveWithdrawal(withdrawalId: Text) : async Result` and `rejectWithdrawal(withdrawalId: Text, reason: Text) : async Result` that update the withdrawal request status in stable storage and adjust the teacher's wallet balance accordingly on approval.

Add a 'System Configuration' tab to the AdminDashboard frontend page. This tab must display and allow editing of: (1) Platform commission rate (shown as a percentage, editable via a number input with a Save button that calls `setPlatformCommissionRate`); (2) Stripe configuration (secret key masked input and allowed-countries multi-select, saving via the existing StripeSetupModal or an inline form); (3) A 'Danger Zone' section containing a clearly styled 'Delete User' action available from the User Management tab's row actions.

Extend the existing AdminDashboard User Management tab to include row-level admin actions for each user: a 'Change Role' dropdown (admin/teacher/student) that calls `setUserRole`, and a 'Delete User' button that opens a confirmation dialog before calling `deleteUser`. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.

Extend the existing AdminDashboard Bookings tab to include admin override actions per booking row: a status override dropdown (pending/confirmed/completed/cancelled) that calls `adminUpdateBookingStatus`, and a 'Delete Booking' button that calls `adminDeleteBooking` after confirmation. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.

Add a 'Content Moderation' tab to the AdminDashboard that lists all reviews and all messages platform-wide (fetched via admin-only backend queries). Each review row must include a 'Delete Review' button calling `deleteReview`. Each message row must include a 'Delete Message' button calling `deleteMessage`. Both must show a confirmation dialog and display success/error toasts. The tab must be disabled in demo mode.

Extend the existing AdminDashboard Withdrawals tab to include 'Approve' and 'Reject' action buttons for each pending withdrawal request, calling `approveWithdrawal` and `rejectWithdrawal` respectively. The Reject action must prompt the admin for a rejection reason before submitting. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.
